items.source: Default is "false", creating a local ForkJoinPool instance based on the "parallelism", "threadFactory", "uncaughtExceptionHandler" and "asyncMode" properties on this FactoryBean.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"，将基于此 FactoryBean 上的 ForkJoinPool、"parallelism"、"threadFactory"、"uncaughtExceptionHandler" 和 "asyncMode" 属性创建一个本地实例。

items.source: NOTE: Setting this flag to "true" effectively ignores all other properties on this FactoryBean, reusing the shared common JDK ForkJoinPool instead. This is a fine choice on JDK 8 but does remove the application's ability to customize ForkJoinPool behavior, in particular the use of custom threads.
items.translation: 注意：将此标志设置为 "true" 将实际上忽略此 FactoryBean 上的所有其他属性，转而复用共享的通用 JDK ForkJoinPool。在 JDK 8 上这是一个不错的选择，但这确实会移除应用程序自定义 ForkJoinPool 行为的能力，特别是使用自定义线程。

items.source: Note that this feature works for the "commonPool" mode as well. The underlying ForkJoinPool won't actually terminate in that case but will wait for all tasks to terminate.
items.translation: 请注意，此功能也适用于"commonPool"模式。在这种情况下，底层的 ForkJoinPool 实际上不会终止，而是会等待所有任务完成。

items.source:
By default, this ForkJoinPool won't wait for the termination of tasks at all.
It will continue to fully execute all ongoing tasks as well as all remaining
tasks in the queue, in parallel to the rest of the container shutting down.
In contrast, if you specify an await-termination period using this property,
this executor will wait for the given time (max) for the termination of tasks.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此 ForkJoinPool 根本不会等待任务终止。它将继续完全执行所有正在运行的任务以及队列中的所有剩余任务，同时容器其余部分也在关闭。相比之下，如果您使用此属性指定一个 await-termination 时间段，此执行器将等待给定时间（最大）以完成任务的终止。

items.source: A Spring FactoryBean that builds and exposes a preconfigured ForkJoinPool.
items.translation: 一个构建并暴露预配置的ForkJoinPool的 Spring FactoryBean。

items.source: Specify the parallelism level. Default is Runtime.availableProcessors().
items.translation: 指定并行级别。默认为 Runtime.availableProcessors()。

items.source: Set the factory for creating new ForkJoinWorkerThreads. Default is ForkJoinPool.defaultForkJoinWorkerThreadFactory.
items.translation: 设置用于创建新 ForkJoinWorkerThreads 的工厂。默认值为 ForkJoinPool.defaultForkJoinWorkerThreadFactory。

items.source: Specify whether to establish a local first-in-first-out scheduling mode for forked tasks that are never joined. This mode (asyncMode = true) may be more appropriate than the default locally stack-based mode in applications in which worker threads only process event-style asynchronous tasks. Default is false.
items.translation: 指定是否为从不加入的派生任务建立本地先进先出调度模式。此模式（asyncMode = true）在仅处理事件式异步任务的 worker 线程的应用程序中，可能比默认的本地基于栈的模式更合适。默认值为 false。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory on destruction of a bean.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在销毁 Bean 时调用。

items.source:
Set the handler for internal worker threads that terminate due to unrecoverable errors
encountered while executing tasks. Default is none.
items.translation: 设置处理内部工作线程因执行任务时遇到不可恢复错误而终止的处理器。默认值为无。

items.source: NOTE: This method returning false does not necessarily indicate that returned objects are independent instances. An implementation of the extended SmartFactoryBean interface may explicitly indicate independent instances through its SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() method. Plain FactoryBean implementations which do not implement this extended interface are simply assumed to always return independent instances if the isSingleton() implementation returns false.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法返回 false 并不一定表示返回的对象是独立实例。实现扩展的SmartFactoryBean接口可以通过其SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype()方法明确指示独立实例。未实现此扩展接口的普通FactoryBean实现，如果isSingleton()实现返回 false，则假定其始终返回独立实例。

items.source: FactoryBeans are allowed to return null objects. The bean factory will consider this as a normal value to be used and will not throw a FactoryBeanNotInitializedException in this case. However, FactoryBean implementations are encouraged to throw FactoryBeanNotInitializedException themselves, as appropriate.
items.translation: FactoryBeans 允许返回 `null` 对象。在此情况下，Bean 工厂会将其视为正常值并使用该值，而不会抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。不过，建议 FactoryBean 实现类根据具体情况自行抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。

items.source: NOTE: If a FactoryBean indicates that it holds a singleton object, the object returned from getObject() might get cached by the owning BeanFactory. Hence, do not return true unless the FactoryBean always exposes the same reference.
items.translation: 注意：如果 FactoryBean 表明它持有一个单例对象，那么从 getObject() 返回的对象可能会被其拥有的 BeanFactory 缓存。因此，除非 FactoryBean 始终暴露相同的引用，否则不要返回 true。

items.source: As with a BeanFactory, this allows support for both the Singleton and Prototype design patterns.
items.translation: 与BeanFactory一样，这支持单例和原型两种设计模式。

items.source: If this FactoryBean is not fully initialized yet at the time of the call (for example because it is involved in a circular reference), throw a corresponding FactoryBeanNotInitializedException.
items.translation: 如果在此调用时该 FactoryBean 尚未完全初始化（例如因为它涉及循环引用），则抛出相应的 FactoryBeanNotInitializedException。

items.source: NOTE: Autowiring will simply ignore FactoryBeans that return null here. Therefore, it is highly recommended to implement this method properly, using the current state of the FactoryBean.
items.translation: 注意： 自动装配将简单地忽略在此处返回`null`的 FactoryBean。因此，强烈建议使用 FactoryBean 的当前状态正确实现此方法。

items.source: The default implementation returns true, since a FactoryBean typically manages a singleton instance.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 true，因为 FactoryBean 通常管理一个单例实例。

items.source: This method can be called before this FactoryBean has been fully initialized. It must not rely on state created during initialization; of course, it can still use such state if available.
items.translation: 此方法可以在该 FactoryBean 完全初始化之前被调用。它不能依赖在初始化期间创建的状态；当然，如果可用，它仍然可以使用此类状态。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
This allows one to check for specific types of beans without
instantiating objects, for example on autowiring.
items.translation: 这允许在例如自动装配时，无需实例化对象即可检查特定类型的 Bean。

items.source:
In the case of implementations that create a singleton object,
this method should try to avoid singleton creation as far as possible;
it should rather estimate the type in advance.
For prototypes, returning a meaningful type here is advisable too.
items.translation: 对于创建单例对象的实现，此方法应尽可能避免创建单例；相反，它应预先估算类型。对于原型对象，在此处返回有意义的类型也是可取的。

items.source:
The singleton status of the FactoryBean itself will generally
be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be
defined as singleton there.
items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的单例状态通常由拥有它的 BeanFactory 提供；通常，它必须在那里被定义为单例。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source: Set whether to expose JDK 8's 'common' ForkJoinPool.
items.translation: 设置是否暴露 JDK 8 的 'common' ForkJoinPool。

items.source: Return the type of object that this FactoryBean creates, or null if not known in advance.
items.translation: 返回此 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如果无法预先确定则返回 `null`。

Return an instance (possibly shared or independent) of the object
managed by this factory.
items.translation: 返回由该工厂管理的对象的实例（可能是共享的或独立的）。

items.source:
Specify whether to establish a local first-in-first-out scheduling mode for forked tasks
that are never joined.
items.translation: 指定是否为从未加入的派生任务建立本地先进先出调度模式。

items.source:
Set the maximum number of seconds that this ForkJoinPool is supposed to block
on shutdown in order to wait for remaining tasks to complete their execution
before the rest of the container continues to shut down.
items.translation: 设置此 ForkJoinPool 在关闭时阻塞的最大秒数，以便等待剩余任务完成执行后，容器其余部分再继续关闭。

items.source: Specify the parallelism level.
items.translation: 指定并行级别。

items.source: Set the factory for creating new ForkJoinWorkerThreads.
items.translation: 设置用于创建新 ForkJoinWorkerThread 的工厂。

items.source:
Set the handler for internal worker threads that terminate due to unrecoverable errors
encountered while executing tasks.
items.translation: 设置内部工作线程的处理器，以处理在执行任务时遇到的不可恢复错误导致的终止。
